methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: cfdelement.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the CFD element. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this CFD element is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the CFD element id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: cfdelement.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the CFD element is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.
